claim_ceiling.notes: This is an evidence-informed candidate register only. National and provincial statistics establish why some interaction classes merit measurement; they do not establish City of Johannesburg prevalence, local crash rates, ODD support, ADS performance, or legal scenario semantics. Every cell remains uncovered until local scope, protocol, independent units, evidence lineage and holdout are registered in the portfolio.

evidence_sources.title: Exploring South Africa’s usual modes of Transport
evidence_sources.geographic_scope: National, with province-level household taxi-use results for Gauteng
evidence_sources.reported_fact: For 2025, 60.6% of learners walked to school nationally; 24.0% of workers used taxis nationally; 38.5% of Gauteng households reported that at least one household member used a taxi in the week before the survey.
evidence_sources.limitations: Learner and worker mode shares are national. The 38.5% figure is household-level weekly use, not a trip share, vehicle share, taxi-rank flow or City of Johannesburg estimate.

evidence_sources.title: Deputy Minister Mkhuleko Hlengwa: SAB Sharp Responsible Partnerships event
evidence_sources.geographic_scope: National South African road safety reporting, 1 January to 27 September 2026
evidence_sources.reported_fact: The speech reports 3,091 pedestrian deaths in the period, approximately 42% of national road fatalities. It also reports that 88% of major crashes are linked to human behaviour, listing excessive speed, loss of control, driving into oncoming traffic, dangerous overtaking, fatigue and alcohol impairment.
evidence_sources.limitations: National aggregate in a government speech; not a Johannesburg risk rate, causal estimate, exposure-adjusted rate or evidence that a particular local scenario occurs at a given frequency.

evidence_sources.title: Gauteng Roads and Transport ramps up road safety interventions
evidence_sources.reported_fact: The Gauteng Department of Roads and Transport identifies scholar-transport safety as a renewed priority and describes stronger enforcement and monitoring.
evidence_sources.limitations: Policy priority is not a measurement of incident frequency, exposure or actual scholar-transport behaviour in Johannesburg.

evidence_sources.title: SA Learner Driver Manual — Rules of the Road
evidence_sources.publisher: National Traffic Information System (NaTIS), Department of Transport
evidence_sources.reported_fact: The manual text describes left-side roadway use on divided public roads and keeping left on the roadway.
evidence_sources.limitations: The surfaced manual is marked draft. Production rule semantics must be confirmed against the current consolidated National Road Traffic Act/Regulations, amendments, signs and local road controls before a safety verifier treats a rule as normative.

evidence_sources.title: A sterling welcome and warning to our international visitors on South African roads
evidence_sources.publisher: South African Government / Road Traffic Management Corporation
evidence_sources.reported_fact: The RTMC communication tells international road users to keep left and pass right.
evidence_sources.limitations: Historical public guidance; not a substitute for current versioned statutory and road-sign semantics. A current authoritative rule pack remains required.

candidate_cells.candidate_scenario: Left-side roadway operation, divided carriageways, lane selection and passing/overtaking manoeuvres on urban arterials and freeways.
local_validation_needed: versioned consolidated NRTA/regulation and traffic-sign rule pack
Johannesburg road geometry and lane-marking survey
independent observed manoeuvre episodes across arterial/freeway strata

candidate_cells.candidate_scenario: Pedestrian crossing of multi-lane urban arterials, including signalised, unsignalised and mid-block crossing opportunities.
candidate_cells.independent_unit: pedestrian-crossing episode grouped by site × day × time window
local_validation_needed: pedestrian counts by site/time and crossing type
instrumented or independently annotated conflict/near-miss episodes

candidate_cells.candidate_scenario: School arrival and dismissal periods with learners walking near school gates, drop-off zones, parking manoeuvres and scholar-transport vehicles.
local_validation_needed: Johannesburg school-site and access-road sampling frame
local learner mode-share and pedestrian-exposure measurement

candidate_cells.candidate_scenario: Minibus taxi stopping, passenger boarding/alighting, curbside re-entry and merging into moving traffic.
candidate_cells.independent_unit: taxi-stop or rank × operating session × day
local_validation_needed: observed dwell, passenger exchange and re-entry trajectories

candidate_cells.candidate_scenario: Taxi-rank circulation with queue spillback, pedestrian desire lines, vehicles entering/exiting and multiple simultaneous passenger exchanges.
local_validation_needed: reciprocal multi-agent interaction observations on sealed rank sites

candidate_cells.candidate_scenario: Curbside pick-up/drop-off and informal stopping where a vehicle manoeuvre intersects pedestrian or cyclist movement.
local_validation_needed: observed passenger exchange and door-opening events

candidate_cells.candidate_scenario: Signalised intersections with turning traffic, pedestrian crossing phases, conflicting approaches and delayed or missed yielding.
Unsignalised intersections, stop-controlled approaches, roundabouts and ambiguous priority/yield interactions.
local_validation_needed: current traffic control and sign inventory

candidate_cells.candidate_scenario: Overtaking, lane changes and oncoming-traffic conflicts, including constrained visibility and mixed vehicle speed profiles.
candidate_cells.independent_unit: manoeuvre episode grouped by road segment × drive-day
local_validation_needed: local road geometry and passing restrictions
independent fatal/serious/non-injury outcome linkage where lawful

candidate_cells.candidate_scenario: Pedestrian presence or crossing on limited-access highways, ramps, interchanges and high-speed approaches.
local_validation_needed: Johannesburg/Gauteng freeway and interchange ODD map
controlled safe test protocol; no deliberate exposure to live high-speed traffic

candidate_cells.candidate_scenario: Low-light, night-time, glare, rain and reduced-visibility combinations affecting pedestrian, cyclist and vehicle detection.
local_validation_needed: factorial combination sampling, not isolated attribute coverage only

candidate_cells.candidate_scenario: Roadworks, potholes, temporary lane shifts, debris and standing water inducing evasive manoeuvres and secondary interactions.
local_validation_needed: JRA/CoJ roadworks and defect inventory with version dates
before/after or controlled safe intervention protocol

candidate_cells.candidate_scenario: Cyclist and motorcycle interactions during passing, turning, lane filtering, blind-spot exposure and curbside door opening.
candidate_cells.independent_unit: actor-dyad episode grouped by corridor × day
local_validation_needed: local cyclist and motorcycle exposure counts
current applicable passing and road-position rules

candidate_cells.candidate_scenario: Traffic-signal outage, manual traffic control, temporary signs and transition back to normal signal operation.
local_validation_needed: CoJ signal fault and restoration records
verified timing of outage/restore and conflicting road users
